_comment: icraft relocation (2026-05-30): Virtue's Prismatic Pond moved from the Overworld to the Deep Aether land biomes of the Aether (tier 4), cloud excluded. Since 2026-10-16 (Aether chip B) the pond is Virtue's altar: the structure is overridden in kubejs/data/terramity/worldgen/structure/prismatic_pond.json to a SURFACE start (the mod buried it at absolute y -20, below the Aether's floor, so it never generated) that refuses a start over void or on broken ground, and kubejs/server_scripts/compat/terramity_virtue_altar.js makes a lance thrown into its prism solution the only summon. New chunks only.
